# r_supp <- rast(file.path(out_dir, "NSWPCT-xref-supporting.tiff"))

# Spatial grid statistics
crs_info <- crs(r_target, describe = TRUE)
crs_label <- sprintf("%s (%s:%s)", crs_info$name[1], crs_info$authority[1], crs_info$code[1])
res_xy <- res(r_target)
pixel_km2 <- prod(res_xy) / 1e6
pixel_ha <- prod(res_xy) / 1e4
n_rows <- nrow(r_target)
n_cols <- ncol(r_target)
n_bands <- nlyr(r_target)
total_cells <- ncell(r_target)
ext_bbox <- as.vector(ext(r_target)) # xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax

# Frequency tables from rasters (the target raster is categorical: values are labels)

    transmute(label = as.character(value), count)

nodata_pixels <- total_cells - mapped_pixels
mapped_area_km2 <- mapped_pixels * pixel_km2

## Author contributions

### Authors

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| label: authors

data.frame(zenodo_meta$creators) |>
    mutate(
        orcidstr = if_else(!is.na(orcid), sprintf(" (ORCID: [%1$s](http://orcid.org/%1$s)) — ", orcid), " — "),
        affstr = if_else(!is.na(affiliation), sprintf("*%s*", affiliation), ""),
        authorstr = sprintf("- **%s**%s%s\n", name, orcidstr, affstr)
    ) |>
    pull(authorstr) |>
    cat()
```

## 3. Spatial Specifications

All three GeoTIFF files (`NSWPCT-xref-target.tiff`, `NSWPCT-xref-membership.tiff`, `NSWPCT-xref-supporting.tiff`) share an identical spatial grid:

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| **Coordinate Reference System (CRS)** | ``r crs_label`` |
| **Spatial Resolution** | ``r sprintf("%g m × %g m", res_xy[1], res_xy[2])`` (``r sprintf("%.4f km²", pixel_km2)`` / ``r sprintf("%.2f ha", pixel_ha)`` per pixel) |
| **Grid Dimensions** | ``r sprintf("%d rows × %d columns × %d band", n_rows, n_cols, n_bands)`` (``r format(total_cells, big.mark = ",")`` total grid cells) |
| **Mapped Pixels** | ``r format(mapped_pixels, big.mark = ",")`` valid pixels (``r sprintf("%s km²", format(round(mapped_area_km2, 2), big.mark = ",", nsmall = 2))`` total mapped area) |
| **NoData (`NA`) Pixels** | ``r format(nodata_pixels, big.mark = ",")`` pixels (outside the SVTM extent, *Not classified*, and PCTs without a cross-reference) |
| **Bounding Box (`xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax`)** | ``r sprintf("%.0f, %.0f, %.0f, %.0f", ext_bbox[1], ext_bbox[2], ext_bbox[3], ext_bbox[4])`` (meters, `r paste0(crs_info$authority[1], ":", crs_info$code[1])`) |
| **Resampling rule** | Nearest neighbour from the 5 m source raster (GDAL `warp`, `-r near`, overviews not used) |
| **Embedded GDAL Metadata Tags** | `AREA_OR_POINT = Area`<br>`PROJECT = Ecosystem Indicators Workflows`<br>`DESCRIPTION = Synthesis of crossreference from NSW PCT (SVTM C3.0) to IUCN GET`<br>`TITLE = <Layer-specific title>` |
